Synopsis:
The player tries to interact with Thaniel, the spirit of the land, after Halsin rescues him from the Shadowfell. Thaniel is unconscious/unresponsive however.Later - Thaniel is recovering and able to talk. A somewhat otherworldly, wise far beyond his years 'child'. He instructs you on what comes next/offers his thanks once you have succeeded.

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_HalsinQuest_Spirit.json: Thaniel is the spirit of the land who was sundered by the Shadowfell and found unconscious until Halsin rescued him; part of his essence (the shadow-child Oliver) had to be reunited with him to lift the curse. The lines assume the player helped drive off Ketheric Thorm and complete the critical beats of the “lift the curse” arc, so Thaniel is now waking, grateful, and oddly childlike but wise. He thanks the player, promises the land will heal in time, and offers a cryptic assurance that a reward will come when it is needed. Prior off‑screen events that shape this scene include Halsin’s rescue, the confrontation with Oliver/return of Thaniel’s heart, and other companion beats (e.g., Art Cullagh/Halsin reactions) that may have already occurred.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_Portal.json: After the player acquires Art's instrument from the Surgeon, and speaks to Art, Halsin is able to use information given by Art to navigate through the Shadowfell, with the intention of recuing Thaniel, the spirit of the land, and ultimately lifting the shadow curse. He asks the player to help him by protecting a portal to the Shadowfell until he can return with Thaniel. He waits by the shore a short distance from Last Light. Once Halsin enters the portal and the dialogue ends, shadow creatures attack. The player must fight off the creatures until Halsin returns. However, if the player attempts to go through the portal themselves, the ritual will fail.
- CAMP_Halsin2.json: Halsin's default dialogue at camp once he's joined you as a follower. You can ask how he's faring in your company, as well as glean some details about your next quest. Halsin is avuncular and scholarly, but his mood grows darker whenever he speaks of Moonrise Towers and the curse that has shrouded it.Once Thaniel, the spirit of the land, has been rescued and brought to camp, a new branch will unlock where Halsin can explain that Thaniel's heart is missing, and it needs to be retrieved in order for the Shadow curse to be lifted. Halsin can be recruited as a companion 11from then on.
- SCE_Halsin.json: This scene is the Act 2 epilogue with Halsin, the druid leader who has been fighting a shadow curse that afflicts the region. Thaniel — a spirit of the land — was sundered by the Shadowfell so part of his essence remains corrupted here; whether the curse can be lifted depends on reuniting and restoring him. Halsin’s lines branch based on the player’s progress: if the land is effectively saved he thanks you and asks to continue with you to Baldur’s Gate; if Thaniel is only partially rescued he urges you to finish the task and offers to join; if restoration is no longer possible Halsin resigns himself to staying behind as sentinel and will not be available as a companion in Act 3. The dialogue assumes prior events (the fragmentation of Thaniel and the campaign against the curse/the Absolute) have already occurred.
- DEN_AttackOnDen_HalsinReturns.json: The Druid Grove has been saved (because either the attacking force was repelled or its leaders were assassinated) and Halsin returns. He thanks the player and reacts to events that may have transpired in the grove during his absence. He's previously promised to help the player with their tadpole problem, but he defers this discussion until the next morning after the victory celebrations.

- Thaniel: You did it. Ketheric Thorm is no more - the shadows' grip is broken. Soon the land shall heal. || [context] NodeContext: Grateful (node 6)
- Player: I'm glad I could help. (node 3)
- Thaniel: Not as glad as I am. || [context] NodeContext: Grateful (node 1)
- Thaniel: Nature moves at its own pace, and bestows its bounty when it sees fit. Give it time - a reward shall come to you, when you need it most. || [context] NodeContext: Knowing (node 11)

context: Thaniel is the land‑spirit who was sundered by the Shadowfell and found unconscious until Halsin rescued him; part of his essence (the shadow‑child Oliver) had to be reunited with him to lift the curse. These lines assume the player helped complete the critical beats of the “lift the curse” arc — Halsin’s descent through the portal, the confrontation that returned Thaniel’s heart, and the drive to expel Ketheric Thorm and the shadow forces. Thaniel is now waking: oddly childlike but timelessly wise, grateful for your aid and promising the land will heal in time. He thanks the player, offers a cryptic assurance that a reward will come when it is needed, and looks forward to the slow recovery of the region.
